title: Слабительное для Сени  (A Laxative for Senya)

segments.t: When Nagiyev learns that Senya ate the pastry containing the diamond ring, he nearly strangles the terrified cook on the spot. Desperate to retrieve the ring before Kristina grows suspicious in the dining room, Barinov mixes an awful kitchen laxative and forces Senya to drink it.
И мы сейчас пытаемся его достать.
Я не буду это пить, я могу отравиться.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'He did what?' Senya brings out the contrast between 'what' and 'to do' in a few short words. Dmitry answers right away.
И мы сейчас пытаемся его достать.
'And right now we are trying to get it back out.' The meaning hinges on 'both' working together with 'to take out' in spoken Russian.
'It was not on purpose.' The grammar packs 'not' and 'on purpose' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Why, you little...' Senya addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'you'. Dmitry answers right away.
'Give me back my ring.' Dmitry brings out the contrast between 'return' and 'for me' in a few short words.
'Quiet, calm down, calm down, calm down.' Kristina brings out the contrast between 'easy' and 'calm down' in a few short words.
'Yes, darling, I am on my way right now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'yes' and 'going' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Dmitry answers right away.
'Did you hear that?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'heard'.
'This old remedy right here.' In Russian, the idea of 'there you go' flows naturally into 'old' without extra filler words.
'It ought to help.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'must' before landing on 'to help'. Dmitry answers right away.
'Senya, open up.' The grammar packs 'Senya' and 'to open' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Я не буду это пить, я могу отравиться.
'I am not going to drink that, I could get poisoned.' Kristina anchors the line on 'I', while 'to get poisoned' completes the thought.
'Drink it right in front of me.' Senya brings out the contrast between 'involved in' and 'for me' in a few short words. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
И мы сейчас пытаемся его достать.
Я не буду это пить, я могу отравиться.

That wraps up this scene as nagiyev explodes when he learns Senya swallowed the ring and joins Chef Barinov in forcing Senya to drink a folk laxative concoction while Kristina waits at the table. See you next time!
